host.description: Target hostname or IP address to scan (required)

output_file.description: Path to output file. If omitted or empty, output goes to stdout.

whois_inet.description: If true, enables -i (internet number whois) module.

netcraft.description: If true, enables -n (netcraft OS/web/server info) module.

portscan_filtered.description: If true, enables -f (show filtered ports) — requires portscan=true.

portscan_banner.description: If true, enables -b (show banners) — requires portscan=true.

portscan_ttl.description: Time To Live (seconds) for portscan timeouts. Must be a positive integer.

email_maxlen.description: Maximum e-mail address length in characters (NCOL 50).
